summary: Sprint 3 (VERA signature engine) verified end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass covering PATCH /api/documents/templates/{id} with signatureMethods; POST /api/documents with signatureMethod + persons persisting the method AND creating one DocumentParticipant per person (status=pending, required=true, method inherited); PATCH /api/documents/{id}/signature-method after creation; POST /api/documents/{id}/participants/{pid}/send for the three channels (whatsapp returns wa.me url, email returns mailto:, link returns /firma/{token}); first send moves the doc to 'shared'; GET /api/sign/{token} returns document+participant, flips participant to 'viewed' and emits participant.viewed event; POST /api/sign/{token} sign path returns {signatureState:'signed', documentStatus:'signed'} when the only required participant signs, sets lockedAt, invalidates the token (subsequent GET+POST both return 404), records participant.signed and document.signed events; POST /api/sign/{token} reject path returns {signatureState:'rejected'}, invalidates token; GET /api/documents/{id}/history contains the full chain (document.created, document.shared, document.participant.sent, document.participant.viewed, document.participant.signed, document.signed). Invalid method rejected with 422; nonexistent token → 404. Frontend E2E via Playwright + qa_varela@vera.test login: /documentos/nuevo → template Autorización → Personas (Cata 💓, vendedor) → NEW step-signature appears with wizard-method-digital + wizard-method-presencial cards; picking 'digital' surfaces wizard-signers with the signer entry; Review → Crear → navigates to /documentos/{id} showing document-detail with detail-doc-status='Borrador', detail-sig-state='Pendiente', detail-method='Digital', detail-participants (Cata · Vendedor · Pendiente + 3 icon buttons send-whatsapp/email/link), detail-timeline (Documento creado), and detail-actions with 'Generar PDF' DISABLED + 'Próximamente' badge. Clicking send-link-{pid} shows detail-flash='Enlace de firma copiado'. Public /firma/{token} (no login): for DIGITAL doc shows sign-ready, no mode selector, typed-name input; submitting → sign-done. For PRESENCIAL doc shows sign-modes with mode-typed/mode-drawn/mode-paper — 'Dibujar' shows sign-canvas, 'En papel' hides canvas; sign-reject → sign-rejected. Reusing the signed token → sign-error. After the digital sign, reloading /documentos/{id}: status='Firmado', sig='Firmado', participant='Firmado' (check icon, no send buttons), timeline shows the full 7-event chain (created → shared → participant.sent → participant.viewed → participant.signed → document.signed).
critical_code_review_comments: documents/signatures.py — clean adapter architecture. SignatureProvider ABC + VeraNativeSignatureProvider is the correct seam for DocuSign/Adobe in the future. Token TTL is a module-level constant (TOKEN_TTL=7d); acceptable now, but consider promoting to template config (per-category expiration) when the roadmap adds it — leaving TODO in code would help.

documents/service.public_sign_view — the 'viewed' transition happens only when signature_status == 'sent'. If the participant is already 'viewed' and reopens the link, the state doesn't change (correct). Good idempotency. However, alreadySigned check triggers only after the sign_token invalidation; before we invalidate, a signed participant that reopens the link would enter here with signature_status='signed' but is_token_valid returns False (sign_token=None). The current path handles it: view returns alreadySigned=false + expired=true, and SignScreen maps expired→'error'. Acceptable, but 'sign-done' would be a friendlier UX for a legitimate signed reopen. Not blocking.

documents/service.submit_signature — token is nulled after sign/reject → find_by_token returns None → 404 (not 410). The spec says '404/410' so accepted, but the intent of 410 ('Gone: link expired') is nicer than a bare 404. If you want strict 410, keep the sign_token but flip signature_status and check is_token_valid first. Non-blocking; tests pass both cases.

documents/service._create_participants — falls back to persons when signers list is empty, but only if signature_method is truthy. That means a doc created without a method never creates participants (correct: method is required to firmar). The UI enforces this via the wizard signature step.

documents/service._hydrate — swallows any exception from participant_repository.list to survive an unmigrated table. Reasonable defensive coding for a post-migration transition, but keep an eye on masking real errors; consider narrowing to the specific missing-table exception (or removing the try/except now that the migration is done per PRD).

SignScreen.tsx — canSign for presencial mode='drawn' returns true even before the user draws anything (hasDrawn.current is a ref not read in canSign). If the user clicks 'Firmar documento' without drawing, submit sends payload with no signatureImage. The backend accepts this (no explicit validation), so an 'empty' drawn signature is possible. Minor UX gap; consider disabling submit until hasDrawn.current is true, or reading a state variable. Not blocking (paper/typed modes also submit valid empty-image data).

SignScreen.tsx — 'mode' payload sent for digital submissions is the string 'digital', but PRESENCIAL_MODES only allows paper|drawn|scanned. The backend stores presencial_mode='digital' for digital signs; harmless (field is Optional and only relevant for presencial rendering) but semantically off. Consider omitting mode for digital.

DocumentDetail.tsx — flash notify uses setTimeout(2500); if the user clicks link twice quickly the last message wins (setFlash overrides). Fine. Also: after all participants sign, the doc becomes locked and 'send' buttons vanish; there's no explicit 'firmado' banner card besides the signed status badge. Minor design polish — the timeline conveys it clearly.

Wizard step-signature: the 'signature methods' comes from template.signatureMethods, and the wizard only shows the step when the array is non-empty. Good — matches the PRD's 'signatureMethods declared by template' contract. If a template has ['digital','presencial'] the wizard defaults signatureMethod to '' (must pick); Sprint 3 spec asked for exactly this — no default. OK.
Test data left in Supabase: several TEST_UI_* and TEST_sig_* documents are now signed/rejected. Since there's no DELETE endpoint, they stay as identifiable rows — acceptable per PRD.
seed_data_creation: Created ~10 TEST_sig_* and TEST_UI_* documents via POST /api/documents (real Supabase, digital + presencial, various states: signed/rejected/shared). Used the shared vendedor person aa3d54c8-4ace-4a57-bbf2-804966547797 (Cata). No templates modified permanently (patched signatureMethods and restored).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Signature engine is fully green. Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_documents_signatures.py covers PATCH template signatureMethods, create with signatureMethod (participants + persistence + invalid method 422), send channels (whatsapp/email/link + shared transition), PATCH signature-method after creation, full digital sign flow (viewed → signed → locked → history chain), reject flow, and invalid/reused token 404/410. Frontend flow verified with Playwright: /documentos/nuevo wizard now has step-signature (data-testid=step-signature) with wizard-method-{digital,presencial} cards and wizard-signers section. After creation, /documentos/{id} shows the detail screen with detail-doc-status, detail-sig-state, detail-method, detail-participants, detail-timeline, action-generate-pdf (disabled + Próximamente badge). Public /firma/{token} handles digital (typed-name), presencial (mode-typed/drawn/paper + canvas), reject and error states. For future extensions: (a) multi-signer scenario (>1 person) so signature_state='in_progress' can be verified in the UI; (b) test the wizard-signer checkbox to make some signers optional; (c) test signature_method 'presencial' with 'scanned' mode (upload image) — SignScreen currently exposes only paper/drawn/typed. No blockers.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. All specified behaviors (template signatureMethods PATCH, document.signatureMethod + participants creation, three send channels sharing one token, viewed transition on GET, sign+invalidate+lockedAt on all-signed, reject transition, complete history chain, wizard signature step, detail screen with disabled Generar PDF, public sign screen digital+presencial+reject+error, E2E copy-link→open→sign→locked) work as expected.
